basis: 2F: outer wall faces measured to dimension ticks for 15000x8000 overall (15000/8000mm chains). One full-height-of-band pier at x=7.48m divides the two conference rooms (north band only, not crossing corridor, per vertical wall-ink profile showing zero support between y=608 and y=793 at that x). Three piers in the south (office) band at x=3.80/7.55/11.29m divide 4 offices (south band only). Corridor bounded by two full-width walls (y=608.5px/4.996m and y=793.5px/2.993m), each wall's door gaps measured from wall-colour pixel profile. Windows measured from cyan hatch extents; north conference windows read from paired 3600mm modules (with a central mullion), south office windows and east/west corridor windows from 1200mm modules. No exterior ground-level door on this floor (upper storey; vertical circulation/stair not shown in supplied plans).
